create_ProfilingContext: create a ProfilingContext to time a code block and log execution metrics to W&B or MLflow
run_profiling_context_with_trainer: run a profiling context from a Trainer instance to automatically extract report_to, step, and main process settings
build_profiling_decorator: build a profiling decorator that times a method and logs execution time via profiling_context for Trainer objects
test_ProfilingContext_direct: test a ProfilingContext with custom name, report_to, is_main_process, step, and metric_prefix parameters
review_profiling_decorator_non_trainer: review the profiling_decorator behavior for non-Trainer objects that have an accelerator attribute but no args
